result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the corner is cluttered with utility poles and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk clutter
hazards.description: Multiple utility and sign poles on the corner restrict pedestrian movement and sightlines.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side may obscure pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk with pedestrian signals and curb ramps, providing basic accessibility. However, the wide roadway lacks a median refuge or curb extensions, leaving pedestrians exposed for the duration of the crossing.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signal control within a mixed-use urban setting. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is well-maintained, the presence of a gas station driveway and outdoor seating near corners creates potential conflict points and sightline issues.

hazards.name: Potential sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Outdoor dining umbrellas and furniture near the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the red building.

hazards.name: Driveway conflict point
hazards.description: The entrance to the gas station creates a conflict point where vehicles cross the pedestrian sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the 7-Eleven sign.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway entrance to the gas station to slow turning vehicles and reduce the conflict area for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban street with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The environment includes a bike lane and street parking, but lacks signalization or physical pedestrian protection like medians.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, immediately preceding the crosswalk.
